note: NEW FAMILY (v0.6.0, hand-authored spec fixture — Rust-native, no Flask recording exists; DECISIONS.md 2026-08-24). App-wide unified OPTIONS: 204, empty body, Allow header (Flask-style comma-space join via the shared automatic_options handler), Content-Type text/html; charset=utf-8 kept, no Content-Length on the wire. Answered by the automatic handler BEFORE any token check — no credentials needed even though the GET requires auth. A CORS preflight (Origin + Access-Control-Request-Method) rides the same 204 with the Access-Control-* headers appended by the after-request CORS layer, exactly as misc/preferences_options_204_cors_preflight.json records.
